messages:
marta: Heads-up — thinking about saved views for the per-route analytics page. Question: should a saved view persist routing policy hints and quota filters, or just the visible UI filters/columns?

alex: my bias = keep saved views small. persist filters + column visibility + scope (personal/team). routing policies can change a lot and will make views brittle. :thinking_face:

jamie: @marta depends on how we reference policies. If we store policy_id only, we can show a warning if the policy changed. Storing full policy blobs feels risky.

sarah: big +1 for storing policy_id + telemetry snapshot id. otherwise metric diffs will be mystifying when sampling or quota rules change.

tyler: UX note: add a checkbox in the save modal: "Include routing & quota context (may become stale)". default off. keeps defaults simple. :white_check_mark:

alex: sketch of minimal saved_view shape: 
```json
{
  "scope": "team",
  "filters": [{"field": "route", "op": "=", "value": "/generate"}],
  "columns": ["latency_p50", "tpm", "model"],
  "metadata": {"telemetry_snapshot": "2025-11-02T15:00:00Z"},
  "routing_ref": {"type": "policy_id", "id": "policy_42"}
}
```

jamie: + a UI affordance to surface "policy drift". if policy_id's semantics changed since snapshot, show an orange badge and diff link.

sarah: also record the effective sampling_rate in the saved view. we had one case where a saved query looked like a regression but sampling was 10% vs 100%.

marta: good call. we should also store which quota dimension was applied (customer vs route) so people don't misinterpret spikes.

ops-bot: savedviews-api v2 deployed to staging — endpoint /api/v2/saved_views now accepts routing_ref and telemetry_snapshot fields.

pm-jen: from product: need to decide default scope and sharing rules. recommend: default = personal, with "share with team" checkbox; team owners can transfer ownership. also audit log entries required when a shared view is edited.

alex: implementation caveat: storing policy_id requires a join on the policy service for render time. that is fine but add a small cache TTL for policy metadata.

jamie: API contract idea for routing_ref: union of {"policy_id": string} | {"inline_policy": string}. inline_policy used only for ad-hoc captures, never for shared/team views.

sarah: telemetry_snapshot should be an opaque id we can look up in logs/evcache rather than a full timestamp. makes comparisons reproducible.

tyler: UX: when applying a shared saved view to a different org/team, warn about missing policies/quotas and offer a migration helper.

marta: putting these into a short spec. I'll open a repo PR with suggested JSON schema, UI text, and migration flow. cc @alex @jamie for review.

alex: thanks — i'll stub the server side validators (scope rules + allowed routing_ref combos).

jamie: i'll prototype the "staleness" badge behavior in the lab branch. quick mock: orange dot + tooltip "routing policy changed since view was saved".

sarah: and i'll add telemetry sampling snapshot queries to the eval harness so saved views can show a before/after comparison.

marta: great, putting a short TODO in the PR to confirm audit event names. will ping when ready. :rocket:
